parityCheck.command: pnpm exec vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts apps/api/test/migration-parity.test.ts --maxWorkers 1
parityCheck.testName: S1 live migration parity > verifies every checkpoint read-only, or explicitly generates only after semantic proofs pass
parityCheck.side: left is SQLite with 8 checks, right is PostgreSQL with 7
parityCheck.rootCauseFact: migrations/postgres/0026_openai_egress.sql line 9 drops agent_job_egress_records_provider_check, which migrations/postgres/0004_agent_jobs.sql line 54 created as provider text NOT NULL CHECK (provider='azure'), and never adds a replacement provider domain check. The SQLite counterpart migrations/sqlite/0070_openai_egress.sql line 12 keeps provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('azure','openai')). Both files carry the same provider shape check, so the single missing constraint is the provider value domain on the PostgreSQL side.
parityCheck.attributedTo: the core merge 3604cb31, not the DESIGN merge
parityCheck.notTheManifest: this is not the missing-checkpoint class of failure seen in F3. The checkpoint openai-egress is registered and the failure is a real semantic difference between the two dialects.
parityCheck.diagnosticRerun: one extra read-only run was made because the first tail did not show the table name. Same failure both times.
